info.name: SF-461 - Validation check updates to Accounts page - API Tests
info.description:
Postman collection for SF-461 API tests. Tests for Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c field validation on Lead and Account.

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create a new environment (or use existing Salesforce QA environment)
3. Set the following environment variables:
   - `sf_base_url`: https://arx--qa.sandbox.my.salesforce.com
   - `sf_api_version`: v60.0
   - `sf_access_token`: Your Salesforce access token (get via OAuth or JWT)
   - `sf_instance_url`: Your Salesforce instance URL

## Authentication:
This collection uses Bearer Token authentication. Obtain an access token via:
- OAuth 2.0 flow
- JWT Bearer Token flow
- Username/Password flow

## Test Scenarios:
- Verify Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c field exists on Lead and Account
- Create Lead with Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c
- Update Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c on Lead
- Query Lead by Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c
- Create Lead with valid Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c value
- Reject invalid Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c values
- Handle null Affiliate_Non_Affiliate__c value
